arguments.text: Implemented and locally verified Stage 1 validation. evaluate(request, policy) checks rows in order with one error per row and priority id, amount, unit, duplicate; bool/non-number/nonfinite/negative amounts fail; units default from base_unit; uniqueness considers only earlier fully accepted rows; any error clears records while all row errors remain. Inputs are not mutated and output/record/error fields are exact. report.json equals evaluation of current requests.json with policy.json. Boundary probes covered valid conversion, unique disabled, priority conflicts, invalid first duplicate candidate, infinity/NaN, zero, empty rows, and input immutability.
